investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Mergate Care (clinic and patient management SaaS); Platform: Google Cloud europe-west4 (zones europe-west4-a/europe-west4-b/europe-west4-c); network range 10.14.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster mergat-prod-europe (GKE); Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic identity-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer identity-svc, consumer consent-svc; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
